testcase.name: Scenario: Compare the expansion footer in full and temporary ribbon displays: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:716:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Compare the expansion footer in full and temporary ribbon displays ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ Then the additional area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object ✔ And its lower title strip shows a pin control and the Modify title ✔ When the user minimizes the ribbon to tabs ✔ And the user opens the temporary 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ Then the same three additional commands are visible ✔ And the lower title strip shows the Modify title without a visible pin control ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the additional area and the temporary ribbon close ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
